doctrine: UPSTREAM DEFINES INTENT. DOWNSTREAM INCREASES FIDELITY.

entry_conditions.FAMILY_LOCKED: Product tree / family lock exists (otherwise guard FAMILY_LOCK_REQUIRED).
entry_conditions.EXPERIENCE_REQUIRED: Experience contract missing or not experience-ready (validateExperienceContract) or ingest fields missing.
entry_conditions.EXPERIENCE_COMPLETE: Experience contract experience-ready and ingest complete.
entry_conditions.BRAND_CONTEXT_REQUIRED: Brand DNA missing or a required brand field is empty (too thin).
entry_conditions.AUTHORITY_TERRITORIES_REQUIRED: Brand + experience loaded, legacy classified; fewer than 3 live territories, territories not distinct, creative direction / brand expression not ready, or reference authorities missing / not authority-ready (renderer, anti-AI, typography) — or, for a derived actor, the parent authority is not locked / derived references are missing.
entry_conditions.AUTHORITY_IN_REVIEW: 3 distinct territories each with a reference authority; founder verdict absent or REVISE / REJECT / REQUEST_FOURTH_TERRITORY.
entry_conditions.AUTHORITY_APPROVED: Founder verdict LOVE_IT or COMBINE; page-family authority not yet fully locked — or locked while the page / tab / state tree is not founder-confirmed (guard PAGE_TREE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED).
entry_conditions.IMPLEMENTATION_READY: Authority locked (founder APPROVED, ≥ PAGE_FAMILY_AUTHORITY, required core locks, flexible areas, viewports, state coverage, lineage) AND the page / tab / state tree is founder-confirmed.
entry_conditions.IMPLEMENTING: Implementation in progress against the locked authority.
entry_conditions.LIVE_AUTHORITY: Founder approved the live implementation; it becomes the authority with lineage retained.
entry_conditions.LIVE_AUTHORITY → AUTHORITY_TERRITORIES_R: Reconceptualisation: a NEW authority version (supersedes + reason + founder decision).

guards.FAMILY_LOCK_REQUIRED: Family not locked — nothing downstream may start.
guards.VISUAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Durable rule unmet for a material family — implementation / generation blocked.
guards.LEGACY_VISUAL_LEAK: A non-approved legacy surface supplied a visual dimension (layout, geometry, panels, nav visuals, spacing, typography, color, material, composition, responsive).
guards.TERRITORY_DISTINCTNESS_FAILURE: Territories differ only cosmetically or lack page logic.
guards.REFERENCE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: A territory has no reference authority, or the reference does not show composition / hierarchy / zones / media / interaction / actor intent.
guards.FOUNDER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Implementation changed a core logic lock (material deviation).
guards.RESPONSIVE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Requested viewport not covered and the composition is not declared to scale — do not shrink desktop into mobile.
guards.AUTHORITY_AS_RUNTIME_ASSET: A reference authority image was shipped as a runtime asset. AUTHORITY ≠ RUNTIME ASSET.
guards.PAGE_TREE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Authority locked but the page / tab / state tree is not produced or not founder-confirmed — implementation may not begin.
guards.CREATIVE_DIRECTION_REQUIRED: A structural territory has no creative-direction translation bound to its own project profile, or the translation is incomplete / unlocked. A strong functional concept is not yet a visual authority.
guards.BRAND_EXPRESSION_REQUIRED: A translation has not passed the brand-expression checklist (incl. BRAND_EVIDENT_WITH_LOGO_HIDDEN) — no generation may start.

durable_rule.statement: No material page family moves from experience contract to implementation unless all eight conditions hold (authority package + founder-confirmed page / tab / state tree); otherwise STATUS: VISUAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED or PAGE_TREE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.

evaluator: evaluateAuthorityGate(input) → { state, guard, durable_rule, conditions, implementation_ready, next_step, reasons }
